witness.branch: Yield precedence and wait for a traffic gap before entry.
witness.quote: The operator of a vehicle entering a roundabout shall yield the right-of-way to vehicles already in the roundabout and wait for a gap in traffic before entering.
witness.reason: The fixed entry task and other vehicle support both duties when the other vehicle is already within the roundabout.
required_context: Distinguish entry at the defined roundabout boundary from entry onto the circulatory roadway.

Place and document the other vehicle already within the roundabout, including its route, speed, direction, proximity and potential entry conflict.
